why_this_part: This is the T7/T8-compliant answer for the FIVE 2N5551 instances in the gain block: the tail current sink (circuits/preamp/gain_block.py:262), the two cascode transistors of ADR-014 (291-292), the VAS load current sink (328) and the Vbe multiplier / bias spreader (350). It is NOT a different device: MMBT5551 is the same 2N5551 die the design was built around, in SOT-23 instead of TO-92. See ADR-017.

spice_model.status: FOUND, published by the manufacturer, and PROVEN to load and run in ngspice.
spice_model.no_flicker_noise: No KF or AF, so NO 1/f noise. Same gap as every other vendor model in this repo except the LSK489. This matters more for this part than for most: NC-004 records that the dominant noise contributors at 1 kHz sit in the input-stage current mirror and its degeneration resistors, and the cascodes fed by these devices are next to them. Any noise figure that leans on this device is a floor without flicker.
spice_model.pspice_quasi_saturation_parameters: QUASIMOD=1, RCO=170, VO=35, GAMMA=2.2E-7. ngspice 47 accepted the file with ZERO warnings - meaningful because ngspice does warn on parameters it does not know (four such warnings on models/jfet/lsk489.lib).

datasheet_cross_check_L24.method: The L6+L7 procedure: measure the vendor model at the vendor datasheet's own test conditions, 25 C, and compare against the vendor's own published window.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.hFE_at_IC_10mA_VCE_5V_25C: MEASURED 107.2 against the datasheet window 80..250. INSIDE.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.fT_at_IC_10mA_VCE_10V_25C: MEASURED 173.1 MHz against 100 MHz minimum / 300 MHz typical. INSIDE.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.C_obo_at_VCB_10V_1MHz_25C: MEASURED 2.221 pF against a datasheet MAXIMUM of 6 pF. INSIDE.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.verdict: CONFORMING on all three published limits.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.fT_at_the_design_s_own_currents: MEASURED 151.9 MHz at IC = 6 mA (VAS load sink) and 88.8 MHz at IC = 2 mA (tail sink and the two ADR-014 cascodes), both at VCE = 10 V. Only the current was changed from the datasheet condition, so the difference isolates the current dependence. AT 2 mA THE MODEL FALLS BELOW THE DATASHEET'S 100 MHz MINIMUM FIGURE - which is not a contradiction, because that minimum is specified at 10 mA. It is the concrete form of the warning already in this repo's NC-017: 'fT 100 MHz min, and measured at 10 mA while the circuit works at 2-6 mA, where it is lower still'.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.against_the_placeholder_it_replaces: spice/preamp/placeholder_devices.lib NSS2N5551 has TF = 0.5 ns, about 318 MHz, and its comment claims 'fT ~ 300 MHz'. Measured reality at the cascode operating point: 88.8 MHz. The placeholder is roughly 3.6x FAST there. Together with the MJE placeholders being about 2.8x fast and the PTHAT320 placeholder being about 3x SLOW, this is why ADR-016 says the present phase-margin figures are 'not conservative in a known direction'.
